  simpa [← toFinset_eq hl, ← toFinset_eq hl'] using h

  simp only [Finset.subset_iff, Multiset.subset_iff, Multiset.mem_toFinset]

  simp_rw [Finset.ssubset_def, toFinset_subset]
  rfl
